content.text: Analyze the GKE environment driver in harbor/src/harbor/environments/gke.py and summarize key capabilities.

The GKE environment driver in `src/harbor/environments/gke.py` provides high-concurrency sandbox orchestration for evaluations:
1. Dynamically provisions Pods on GKE clusters.
2. Injects in-memory tarball streams directly into Pod stdin.
3. Runs Docker-in-Docker (DinD) for tasks requiring container creation.
4. Recovers logs and test verifier reward.txt files directly from Kubernetes streams.
Yes! When deployed with an appropriate GKE node pool and autoscaler, Harbor orchestrates hundreds or thousands of simultaneous trial sandboxes concurrently.
